name: CHRYSAOR
description: Chrysaor is new, named after the golden-sword son of Medusa. It's gold and black like a Marshall, in the same family as Melinoe, Hyperion and the tarot amps: black lacquer with gold baroque scrollwork, and a winged sword in a laurel wreath under a crown. Below that is a brushed-gold control panel with the 2203's six knobs in their real order, the inputs on the right, and the power lamp on the left.
